note: Overlay folders (first segment of the overlay rel) whose pages draw chat or alerts and so get the /display feed scope. Every other overlay gets the effects scope (masked chat text). Widen only with the user's yes.
effectPagesNote: Effects-scope folders whose page fires one named effect itself on chat (legacy/overlays/chat-charge, chat-storm). They connect at /effects/<name>, so every chat-fired play passes the effect guards (budget, cooldown, region, flash; data/effects/guards.json) and the chat-effects flag. Names must exist in data/effects/guards.json effects.
